title: aster acris subsp. trinervis
intro: Aster acris subsp. trinervis, commonly known as Alpine Hawk's Beard or Alpine White Hawk's Beard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is native to high-altitude mountainous regions in Europe and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aster acris subsp. trinervis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial activities. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin disorders, and is also used in herbal teas and infusions for its medicinal properties.
